title: Monorepo scaffold: npm workspaces, docker compose Postgres 16, lint/typecheck/test scripts, README, ARCHITECTURE.md
user_visible_behavior: On a clean clone: docker compose up -d db && npm ci && npm run lint && npm run typecheck all exit 0.

title: Migration runner + db:test running the provided 001/002 migrations and SQL tests
user_visible_behavior: npm run db:test applies 001+002 to a fresh DB and both SQL test files print their ALL ... PASSED line.

title: Config + crypto lib: env validation (Zod), HMAC hash matching secure_hash(), AES-256-GCM encrypt/decrypt, masking helpers
user_visible_behavior: TS hash of an NI/account equals SQL secure_hash() for the same key; missing env vars fail fast with a clear message.

title: Auth + roles (admin/accounts/staff/readonly) + per-request audit context (SET LOCAL app.user_email) + app shell with login
Branches, bank accounts, landlords, properties: API + UI (list, search, create, edit)
Tenants + tenancies: TID, RG/MG/IRG, joint tenants, NI stored encrypted+hashed+last3, search by TID/name/NI; tenancy end flow
user_visible_behavior: Staff search a tenant by TID, name or full NI; NI is never shown in full except to admin/accounts; ending a tenancy requires an end date.

title: Rent terms: rent schedules, benefit awards (LHA/UC/HB), payer splits, payment methods; nightly charge generation job + rent account view per tenancy
user_visible_behavior: On a tenancy page staff set rent + cycle, add an HB award of a fixed amount and see the tenant/council split per period and the running balance per payer.

title: Known payer accounts: add/link landlord, relative or tenant accounts (hash + last4) to a tenancy or landlord
LetMC import: tenants, tenancies, properties, landlords + opening balances at a cutover date; dry-run report before commit
user_visible_behavior: Import a (synthetic) LetMC export in dry-run; see counts, duplicates and rejects; commit; arrears appear as opening_balance charges, credits as negative adjustments.

title: Bank CSV ingest: upload, profile by header name, dedupe, raw row kept, extraction of TID/NI/payer account; CSV profile admin screen
user_visible_behavior: Uploading each of 7 synthetic bank files (columns reordered/renamed per bank) imports the expected rows; re-upload is rejected; an overlapping file inserts only new lines; an unknown layout fails naming the missing fields.

title: Matching service: auto_match on every ingested line, match summary per import, API for suggestions / confirm / remember / reject
user_visible_behavior: After upload the summary shows N matched automatically, N for review, N yet to take, N excluded.

title: Review queue UI: suggestions with confidence + reason, accept / pick another tenancy / remember payer, yet-to-take list with manual match
Receipt operations: split a bulk council payment / upload remittance, manual allocation override, reverse a receipt, adjustments (write-off, refund)
Filled-in bank statement CSV download (replaces the Google Sheet) with filters by bank/date/status
Vico export from v_vico_export: file download (TID, amount, constant sort code/account), marks each receipt exported once via external_refs
Xero sync: OAuth2, contact mapping, one draft invoice per receipt (ledger code + branch tracking), status read-back, idempotent outbox worker; field map from integration_settings
user_visible_behavior: Against a mocked Xero API: one invoice per receipt, retries never duplicate, APPROVED/VOIDED flows back. A real sandbox run is a manual step.

title: Dashboard: today's imports per bank, auto-match rate, review backlog, balances per payer, arrears ageing, tenant rent statement (PDF/CSV)
